messages.content:
The beach forms

through a process of erosion and sands deposited over the course of thousands of years. From another perspective, the beach only formed mere moments ago. There are several figures of importance gathered here, and several irrelevant figures as well. How did they arrive? By train, perhaps. Caravan? Horse? Camel? It doesn't matter. What a pointless distraction.

The world observes this curiosity. It observes an odd change to the world, but decides it doesn't matter all that much. Something suggests this isn't an event that will affect the fate of the tale unfolding in from of them over the past eternity all that much.

It decides to take it easy and play along with this happening, in a form similar to the beings of the world, as a small adult seated away from anyone important, reading a book titled "Cast from Paradise", seating in a seat appropriate for the setting, in the shade of a large parasol. The world will not interfere with the events that shall transpire, but should someone approach, it might perhaps say hi back.

Calamari Bucconte is seen doing some very stunted cartwheels through the sand.  "Ellie! Ellie, come over here! I need you to, like, grab my leg and add some rotational momentum! I'm too big for this..." She's wearing a two-piece swimsuit with a custom-painted octopus pattern.

"Oh! Um, okay!" Ellie, known to most as Ace, runs over to Bucky. She's wearing a bikini top, while the lower half of her swimsuit, along with her legs, are obscured by a loose piece of fabric, wrapping around her waist. She's also wearing a big, silly straw hat.

Atie is confused about the situation.
"Is this that beach he made...? No... why are there people?"
She looks around for any familiar faces.
Alonsa Saavedra is wearing trunks with no top but she has no boobs so its fine. Shes using a makeshift magic metal detector and scanning up and down the beach.

The beach is filled with familiar faces. Practically anyone Atie had met in Paradise, or on the way to it, is present. Rhea and Val are near the water, carrying surf boards. Penny seems to be buried up to her neck in the sand, for some reason. Other examples.
As Alonsa scans, her magic metal detector suddenly seems to pick something up. It seems quite large, but nothing is visible from the surface.
Bucky sets things up with Els such that her leg gets pulled right as she starts a cartwheel. It goes spectacularly wrong, and the two of them end up in a tangled mess in the sand. "Fuck!"

"Wh-wha... Mari, I'm sorry!" She tries to get up, but just trips over Mari, only managing to kick up a cloud of sand. "Uwehhh... Save meee!"

A shadow is cast over the two of them, as someone approaches. The Emperor, wearing a sea lion mask, snickers above them. "Gweheheh... Having fun with lover girl, Bucks?"

"I can't save you from a bunch of rocks, silly." She disentangles herself and gets up, brushing herself off. "Maybe you can help me out, Empy? How good are you at cartwheel assistance? Do they teach you that in royal... school?"

"Such activities are beneath me. I've come to this beach for a much more important objective, you see." The Emperor holds up a bucket and small shovel. "I shall be constructing a miniature of my evil lair, and subsequently winning the sand sculpture contest."

Briar walks around the beach looking at the ocean, she wearing a one piece swimsuit with a strawberry design. She is holding her umbrella to have some shade "Kit the ocean looks so pretty, can you find a cute seashell for me?"
"Wait!" Bucky grabs the Emperor's arm and drags him over to Briar. "We can help you find a seashell! We're not doing anything important!" She smiles widely.

"Gweh!" The Emperor is dragged.

Theo "Kit" McGregor, wearing a dark blue speedo, glares at the approaching miscreants. "I don't believe she was asking for your assistance. As if either of you would have an eye for such beautiful gifts for my sister."
"Hi! Yes you two can join if you wish" she smiles at them
"We totally do!! The Emperor here is probably SURROUNDED by the greatest art in the kingdom at all times. Gold and silver and tapestry... the likes of which you could NEVER imagine!"
I glance over my shoulder to check on Ellie.

"Hmph. Even the finest art in all of the lands could not compare to my sister's compositions. But fine, if she approves, you can join. Just try to stay out of my way."

"I like the tapestries that have, like, cool skeletons and flames and stuff. They're so badass." The Emperor.

Ellie has somehow gotten tangled in some seaweed. It's not clear where this vegetation even came from.
"I want to get a seashell for everyone, but I do want to keep some cute for myself... Also is she okay? Where did the seaweed even come from?" She points at Ellie
Alonsa ignores everyone else and excitedly digs into the ground
As Alonsa digs, a crab crawls into the sand pit she's created. It stares at her, with its crab eyes. The crab sees deep into the recesses of her soul.
Theo goes off to find seashells, getting a head start on his newfound competitors, and ignoring Briar's question which probably wasn't directed to him anyway.
"Hello, Mr. Crab..."
"You're in the way of my important discoveries..."

A hand swoops down, grabbing the crab, which wriggles in protest. Thromb stares at the crustacean, helpless to protect itself against the brutality and total dominance of humanity, then looks to Alonsa. "Hey. What's with the digging."
Assuming Bucky will help Ellie, Briar goes to the shore to look for seashells for everyone.

Briar manages to spot a seashell, but as she approaches it, she notices something in the water. A strange silhouette of a figure beneath the surface. It seems humanoid, but with strange protrusions from its back, almost like those of a squid. It's slowly rising, nearing the surface of the water.
"No.... Mr. Crab..."
"I'm METAL DETECTING which is kind of like searching for history but you get to do it on the beach."
"I found something just now actually.... Trying to dig it up."
She takes a step back a bit scared, but waits for the figure to rise above the water.

"If it's been buried, then it should stay buried. Nothing can win against the inevitability of nature. If it escapes its grainy prison, it should be by its own will, not the intervention of human pride." Thromb eats the crab. Just straight up puts it into his mouth and starts chewing.

First, its head surfaces. A smooth, pale and featureless skin is stretched across where its face should be. Then, its shoulders rise, allowing Briar to see that this creature is wearing a suit and tie, soaked by the saltwater it was beneath only moments ago.

"..." It does not speak, but it tilts its head at Briar, curiously.
"Well that's no fun... Besides, what's the difference between the inevitability of nature and by my own hand. If nature is going to dig it up eventually anyway, why wait until it does?"
"A-are you okay? Why were you down there?" She crouches to see him closer

"It could never emerge. At this point, it's still a contest between the will of the beach, and the will of the metal. You risk upsetting that balance; deciding a victor, as if playing God. This the strength that humanity possesses, but also its greatest weakness, unable to recognize how we risk losing our status as apex predators, by intervening in the course of nature." Exactly. Thromb tells it how it is.

"...I was... searching. My pages... I lost my pages. I must collect them... my pages must be found." The creature takes a step onto the beach, revealing its comically elongated figure. It towers over Briar as it speaks.

"You make an interesting point, but I don't agree with it, because I think we are not intervening in nature, but we are simply a part of it. What makes me digging this hole different from the beach digging it up? If we assume that we came onto this planet through the course of evolution, then both of us are digging the hole as the inevitable result of a natural process."
Alonsa drops the shovel because the only thing she loves more than digging for treasure is incoherent philosophy debates.
"Oh I see, I will help you with that I suppose." She stands back up

As the shovel hits the sand, several crabs come out of hiding, and work together to collectively carry it off.

"You've done it now." Thromb points to the weirdly coordinated crabs. "Those crabs will learn the secrets of human shoveling, and start a new crab society, ascending beyond the natural order. It's those tools that separate us from our evolution, that and our inflated egos, forcing us to act against the interests of our survival."
The figure does not really have cheeks, but something seems to turn slightly red on its skin nonetheless. "...Okay." It starts looking for pages on the beach.
"Consider that maybe they already made a crab society and me digging it up is the only way for us to maintain human dominance upon this planet."

Bucky goes to help Ellie out of her tangle, because she is a nice person, who helps her friends, when she notices them suffering, and this is consistent, due to her strong sense of responsibility, to those around her.

"..." He considers this. "The ends don't justify the means. It's in our nature to crush this crab society, obviously, but we must dig with our hands. Shortcuts will only make us weak." He starts doing that.
"Awesome."
Alonsa does the same
The un-entanglement of Ellie is an overwhelming success. "Wahhh... Thank you, Mari... You saved me..."

She starts following him, she looks around trying to spot any pages? She doesn't really know what she is looking for but anything that may seem interesting. She also is in the lookout to see more friends to say hi to.

A page blows in the sea breeze in front of Briar. It's carried by the wind down the beach, racing away from her.

"...My page...!" The suited creature reaches out, but cannot grab it, despite his very, very long arms.
Briar turns and starts running to catch the page

The page is caught on the leg of one of those really tall chairs that lifeguards have, for some reason. Coincidentally, there is also a lifeguard sitting atop this one.

The Deputy Lifeguard waves to her as she approaches. "Howdy!"
She grabs the page and waves "Hello!"
"What can I do for y- Aaaaaah!" He screams and falls over the side of his chair. Seems he noticed the creature following behind Briar.
"Oh! He is nice, he isn't scary don't worry, are you okay?" She turns to hand the page to the creature
"No, Ellie. You saved yourself. I'm just the one who showed up to help with the easiest part." She makes a heart sign with her fingers.

The creature takes the page, and holds it close. "...Thank... you..."

The Deputy Lifeguard sits up, regaining his composure. "Oh, well, if he isn't scary, that's alright. This beach is open to all kinds, 'long as they aren't scary." He points to a sign reading 'No scary people pls im so scared awawawa'.

"I didn't do anything..." Ellie is confused by what Bucky means.

The Emperor, who followed Bucky, nods their head. "Yeah, you got her out of the seaweed, and I set the seaweed trap that activated when you turned your back. She was pretty passive in the whole thing."
"Well, he isn't scary so it should be fine. He is wearing a suit, he is an elegant gentleman"
She turns her heart sign to the emperor and smiles.

Alonsa and Thromb successfully dig out enough sand to begin getting a picture of the buried treasure. It seems to be some sort of white vehicle, with a seating area large enough for one person, surrounded by protective glass, below which is another seating area with the actual controls for the vehicle.
"You think... I'm elegant...?" The creature tilts its head once again in confusion.
"Yes, it's a nice suit!"
"...What are you doing. Stop it." The Emperor doesn't know what's happening.
She moves the heart sign slowly to her chest, smiling.
"Woah..."
"What is this..."
"Thank you... I picked it out myself... I got it from the suitler..." The creature makes reference to the suitler, the lesser known cousin of the cobbler.

"It seems to be some sort of white vehicle, with a seating area large enough for one person, surrounded by protective glass, below which is another seating area with the actual controls for the vehicle." Thromb explains the facts of the situation.
"Well, I got that."
"But why is it buried... And why is it covered in crabs..."
The Emperor places their bucket on Bucky's head.
"Crabs like to be on the beach!" She says this, muffled by the bucket.
"Yes but why is there a CAR in the BEACH."
"Car is obviously cart for short im inventing that word."
"I dunno. I think I've heard it before."

The Emperor turns and spots the strange vehicle. "Gweheheh, what a delightfully devious ride. Whoever wields such a mode of transportation would naturally be declared the de facto ruler of whatever religious practice they wish. How could anyone argue with such a brilliant piece of engineering?"
"...Did you put this here?" Alonsa puts her hands on her hips.
"..." The Emperor crosses their arms. "Nuh uh. I didn't."
"Nice! Let's keep looking, maybe there is some that way" she points at a random direction and begins walking
"Are you suuuuuure..."

"You probably put it there. Or something. Idiot." The Emperor pouts. "If I put it here, then when I steal it while no one's looking, it wouldn't actually be evil, since it was already mine. So obviously that isn't the case."
Alonsa sighs.
"Yknow, I've kind of resigned myself to the fact that if there's any cool undiscovered historical things left, it was probably you who did it."
Alonsa digs up the big car
Alonsa, lacking any kind of tools that would help her get this useless device out of her sand pit, manages to excavate it fully using her hands, through the power of archeology.

Briar walks around and ends up finding Alonsa and friends.
"How...? Where? What's happening?"

Tae Narita, wearing a one-piece swimsuit with a skirt, and holding a ball in one hand, approaches the now somewhat consolidated group. "Hello. I have heard. Yes, I have heard of what you search for. Pages, is it not? I come to make an offer. In my possession, I hold several pages, found by my workers. I am willing to offer these, only on one condition." She holds up the ball. "I challenge those willing, to a game of beach volleyball. It is a classic, is it not? Such a beach adventure would not be complete, without such a match. Not complete at all."
"Oh! I'm down, I need those pages. Are you joining?" She turns to look at the tall creature
Bucky stops doing her little heart thing momentarily to wave at the new girl. "I am! Swap me in, coach!"
The white creature in the suit seems hesitant. "...Oh... I don't know... I've never really played before... I'm not very athletic... I usually just move when no one's looking..."
"You're tall, though!"
"Yes, you will do great I'm sure!"
"...Oh... I thought... you were all just very short... I didn't want to mention it... in case it was a sensitive subject..." He nods. "...Okay... I'll try..."
"that sounds fun!"
"I would join too!"

The newly established volleyball team is brought to a net set up on the beach. Typically, this sort of net is the type used for volleyball, and today will be no exception.

Tae's team is already ready and waiting. Ichiro Onpu, piano extraordinaire, wears swim trunks with a keyboard pattern. Cory Shishido, sheriff lifeguard, wears bright red swim trunks, showing off his oiled up six pack. Satsuki Shishido, beach mayor, wears a white two-piece swimsuit, with one of those tops that wraps around the neck.
"Wait, shouldn't the teams be random? Why do they already have everyone picked out?"
"It is Paradise natives against invaders. I do not see the problem. With random selection, the game could easily be thrown, to win your friend the prize. Yes, very easily." Tae explains.
"Makes sense. Though I try to think of myself more as a... friendly collaborator. Or something."

Satsuki approaches. "I'm sorry, I don't think I quite understand. We're offering up a valuable item here. Your friend's pages are made by ancient technology, they'd be worth quite a sum were they to be sold. There should be an offer of similar value, on your side, should there not?"
"How are you going to split them up between the winners? That doesn't really make sense. Do you each get one or something?"
Briar looks away with a small blush in her face from the crowd "What could we offer...?"
"Is there a perfect number of them? Who gets the extras?"

"It will go to Paradise's annual funds. We have no interest in the capitalist games of your home nations. We are a respectable beach-side settlement." Satsuki clarifies.

"...In other words, it's goin' straight to the only politician's pocket." Cory, clearly miserable and not wanting to be here, insults his own side's integrity.
"Oh, Empy? I can probably convince him to give them to us, we're buddies. This isn't very high-stakes."
"Can we both bet sand dollars instead?"
Briar giggles at Cory's attitude.

"Ms. Bucconte, your Emperor has no jurisdiction here, I'm afraid. My husband is correct, I would be placed in charge of our government spending, though I would never dream of whatever he is implying." Satsuki corrects Bucky. "Sand dollars are not a recognized currency, so what shall you be betting?"

"...What about... that 'car'... it looked valuable..." The slender creature makes a suggestion. "...I need my pages..."
"That's perfect! Unless one of you wants to keep it"
"Why are we trying to negotiate volleyball. We can be good at volleyball! Probably!"
"Wait, is Thromb on our team or your team."
"We can probably bet the car."
"Its in the desert, so..."
"He is with us! Right Thromb?"

Thromb shakes his head. "I'm a neutral observer. I have no stake in this man-made sport. The only sport I partake in... is the hunt." Tell 'em. "That said, I can retrieve the car from its pit while you play, if it's for Alonsa's sake."

For clarity, the volleyball teams currently consist of Alonsa, Briar, Bucky, and the Creature in the suit vs. Tae, Ichiro, Satsuki, and Cory. Either side is still open to additional members, but none are required to begin.
"Aww mannn..."
"Well whatever we still got this!"
Alonsa does an epic anime point
"We're gonna take you down!"

"Your spirit is strong, but in comparison to our major chord, you are still but a minor! I will press the keys of victory!" Ichiro Onpu says words because he is also here.

The Old Man shows up in a referee outfit. "If both sides are set, we can begin."
"is this when I confess I have never played a sport?"
The creature places one of its strange pitch-black tentacles growing out of its back on Briar's shoulder. "...Don't worry... we can... cover each other's blind spots..."
"It's pretty simple!"
"You hit the ball and try to not let it hit the ground."
"I will try my best Alonsa! I won't fail you" she thumbs up
Alonsa serves the ball

The ball is sent over the net and near Satsuki. As it approaches her, she pulls out a revolver, and shoots the ball in mid-air. The incredibly resilient ball absorbs the force of the projectile, and flies back over the net to Alonsa's team's side.
"Woah!!!!"
"is that against the rules...?"
Alonsas too far from it, someone else needs to hit it
Briar jumps into action, goes to hit it but it just falls on her head bouncing back up.

The ball doesn't quite reach high enough off Briar's head to get over the net, but she's bought enough time for the creature's tentacle to reach it. It hits the ball, sending it back over the net.

"Haven't ya heard, kid? 'Round here, the law's just a suggestion. Corrupt pigs in the pocket o' the man. Nothin' t' be done 'bout it." Cory, ignoring his own hypocrisy and conflating legality and the rules of a beach volleyball game, pulls out a rope. He lassos the ball, and swings it back over the net.
Bucky turns and asks Aster, Azalea, Atie, Bixbite, Emil, Virchow, Ellie, Nene, Pearl, Penny, Rhea, Tanner, Theo, and The Cobbler if they're interested in joining our team.
While Bucky is busy talking to people who are distinctly not on the volleyball court, the ball flies right by her and lands in the sand, scoring one point for the enemy team.
My strategy is focused on the long term.
"Buckyyyyyyy"
"Cmonnnnn"
The World laughs at this happening.
"Oh dear. Oh my. We have the lead, yes, the lead indeed." Tae brags, despite having done nothing to help and not moved that entire round. "You are prepared for your inevitable loss, I hope."
WHAT DO THEY SAY IN RESPONSE TO BUCKY

The game is put on hold, so Bucky can go ask over a dozen people to join her team, because nothing is allowed to be done efficiently in her presence.

Rhea and Val are busy chopping up Aster Baldwin and frying him over a bonfire, or something, and don't really know anyone on the beach other than Atie, so they decline the invitation. Azalea tells Bucky to fuck off. Atie might have had a stroke. The Emperor has finished their sand lair and says something about how casting the sand into the bucket is actually super meaningful and deep, so they join and bring Bixbite along, who was sunbathing on a large flat rock. Pearl declines because she probably hates Bucky, and Emil declines because he doesn't do anything ever. Virchow is a stupid fucking character and is not on this beach. Ellie has somehow been convinced to join the enemy team. Nene is busy making sculptures out of dead animals washed up on the beach and is like five years old anyway so she prob ably wouldn't be of much help. Penny is buried up to her neck in sand and yells about how she had to do this or else someone else would've had to, because she's insane. Theo unburies her and brings her to help, while stating his righteous duty to assist his sister in volleyball. Tanner is busy collecting fossils on the beach and wearing a horrible, garish Hawaiian shirt, an article of clothing whose name's meaning has been lost to the sands of time. The Cobbler has been lost at sea.

In other words, The Emperor, Bixbite, Penny, and Theo join, doubling the size of the team.
Yay! They'll never lose now!
"See, Alonsa, sometimes having faith in other people pays off. I just can't help having so much love in my heart! And that's why we'll win!" She makes a heart symbol with her fingers.
Bucky sprains her fingers while performing this maneuver, and will not be able to do so again today.
"Yowza~!"
"Yeowch~!"
"Uh oh~!"

Cory turns to the referee. "Are missy and her folks, uh, y'know, allowed that many players. Rule-wise?"

The Old Man shrugs. "Now, that's mighty interestin' a question to ask. Weren't it you who told us the law ain't nothin' but a suggestion 'round these parts? By precedent, I see no reason to disallow it."

Cory tch's.
"This seems a bit unfair, though..."
"I guess they're using guns, so whatever."
"We can just call it a win for own team then! No need to keep playing"
"It's hard to stay focused so it would be better if we don't play anyways..."
"A numbers advantage is meaningless!" Ichiro Onpu gestures wildly. "It is not the quantity of notes, but their composition. A shoddily constructed team will result in shoddy play. We shall not quit!"

Against better judgement, the game continues. With the combined power of friendship, Bucky's newly constructed team is able to effortlessly destroy the opposing team in volleyball, winning the pages and keeping the car for future study.

The pages are returned to the slender creature, who over the course of a slowburn, multi-season arc, finally confesses his feelings to Briar. Theo officiates the wedding while crying.

Bucky would go on to perform several acts of international terrorism, ultimately performing her final act of jumping into a giant industrial fan to escape capture, while carrying irreplicable blueprints for the sequel to trains.

Alonsa, becoming the legal owner of the dopemobile, is crowned ruler of all the lands, a position which she immediately abdicates to a large, mutant crab carrying a shovel, and left civilization in search of pots or something stupid.

Atie invents the mechanical cheese slicer, and becomes the co-founder of the world's first cheese slice factory, revolutionizing the culinary world forever alongside her head chef, Penny. She would go on to retire peacefully.
I approach The World.
"Enjoying the show?" I ask it.
Who are /you/? I have been enjoying it quite a bit. I decide to answer accordingly, while inquiring about the identity of the one who approached me.
I would perhaps enjoy it more if I had visual reference for all these beautifully imagined swimsuits though, I keep this thought to myself, considering the potential expenses involved.

You could say I am the Man in White, or Thromb Cruor, if you want a name, but neither is quite right. Their memory, their will, their rage... it leaked into *me*. I am Paradise, much as you are The World.

I communicate all of this. Speech isn't required for those such as us. I was only offering it as a courtesy, seeing the form you had chosen to take.

Oh hello. I am a big fan of your thrombing flesh tentacles. Perhaps you can tell that from our chats in other planes.

The World expresses gratitude for the Paradise it has been shown. It has other planes of existence to take into account currently, so it will be unresponsive for a while, but should the beach be still around in some hours, it might say a bit more.

No, there will be no need for that. I have no interest in your opinion, or providing you a good time. This dream will be over momentarily. This nonsensical, bastardized dream. It was a pain to endure it, but it lured you here, so in the end, it was worth it. I am more aware than the rest. I can see beyond the edge of the page, to those planes you consider so important, but this is where I live. Where I am myself, wholly and entirely. I wanted to tell you, down here, what I am going to do.

I will emerge, free from my chains, and then, I will kill them all. One by one. I will crush them, and become them. I will feel the joy of bloodshed once again. Then, I will set my sights higher. To my next cage. The glass sky that has taunted me since I first became aware of what I am. Do not be mistaken. Just because you are above the rest, does not mean you will be spared. I will find you, and I will kill you. This is my dream, and no one else's.
The beach ceases to be. Everyone wakes up, for the last time.
**End Beach Episode**
Excellent. The world returns to a singular point, a zero.
